evidence.reason: `_expand_instance` exists to make `Service=%i`/`%i.service` resolve to the CRQ unit for an instantiated unit such as `ingress@crq-tick.socket`. The regex only accepts a dot-free instance (`[^.]*` before the final `.suffix`), but systemd's unit name form is `<template>@<instance>.<type suffix>`, and the instance may itself contain dots. For a valid dotted instance (e.g. `ingress@crq-tick.service.socket`, or `ingress@crq-tick.foo.socket`), `re.match` returns `None`, the function silently returns the raw value, and `%i` stays unexpanded, so the dependency scan cannot see the CRQ unit — precisely the failure the helper was added to prevent. The smallest compatible fix is to capture the instance up to the last suffix, e.g. `r"[^@]*@(?P<instance>.+)\.[^.]+\Z"`; the reviewer's alternative of refusing unresolved specifiers is a separate behavior change, not required for the fix.
